description: Plan step R4a (graph node rules). If the probe cannot run on this machine, record why and which steps therefore cannot be probe-verified, then continue with the other gates.

Specs first (new tests/rules-gate.spec.ts, extend tests/rules-row.spec.ts, tests/contracts.spec.ts, tests/fake-rc3.ts): the listener runs next() first and returns any non-allow unchanged (guard and graph-files rules win); rules:files-only denies writes into <root>/docs/rules/, the same relative path in other worktrees (git worktree list cached 60 s) and <project>/.llm/rules/ for file tools and for shell writes that file-tools-only recognises, for direct calls and for calls with parent (run_code), reads are not blocked, the denial is written to the violation journal as rules:files-only; block rules deny with the four-part text naming the rule, who set it and since when, why it holds now, and the right path; record rules allow and write a mode 'record' journal line; inform rules never change a verdict; events: gate.tool-call every call, gate.dispatch when the native name is in DISPATCH_TOOL_NAMES (subagent, subagent_fork), never gate.trunk-advance (declared only); role: main agent via the hournessMainAgent projection fallback (impl-plan Interpretations 6), subagent from session header origin, else root; model from the session's latest request header (src/shared/route.ts sessionRoute); judge/state read errors allow and degrade row health with the reason; pricing service absent / wrong shape / peak throwing give three different unreadable reasons without degrading health; rules_show lists rules effective for the caller, default rule at peak time, signals with source, never truncates; /rules handler runs as the human and each subcommand writes the documented op, refused ones answer one Chinese line; the glm:guard declaration section gets exactly one extra line when the rules service is present and none otherwise; DISPATCH_TOOL_NAMES and RULES_TOOL_NAMES exist in src/shared/tool-names.ts with a contract test.

Implement: src/rules/gate.ts (listener + files-only), src/rules/index.ts wiring (prepend registration, rules_show tool, full /rules, provideRowHealth, ctx.provide of the existing peak service unchanged), src/shared/plugin-labels.ts (pluginLabel for the two package names, caller: rules_show provenance line), src/shared/tool-names.ts, src/guard/index.ts (only the one-line declaration, read through a service), packages/hourness/locale/rules/*.json meta, docs updates (ORCHESTRATION.md section 16, DESIGN.md row table + interface table + degradation table). Do not register rules_propose, /rules accept|reject or any proposal operation (blocked). Do not change the patch's disabled: true.

Probe: add scenarios glm-rules and non-glm-rules to scripts/probe/run-probe.mjs. The scenario project preplaces docs/rules/rules.json with: one block rule on command text 'rules-probe-blocked' and one inform rule. Person-defined switches cannot be created yet (the operation is blocked), so queue behaviour is probed in FEAT-007 with a queue rule on 'glm-peak is true' under the probe clock. Do not preplace script rules (impl-plan Interpretations 13). Assertions: the blocked call does not execute and a rules: record is in the violation journal; direct write into the rules directory is blocked; the request carries no rules reminder yet; /glm-status has a rules line; the scenario's user-level directory has no rules/ folder.
Commit in at most two commits: the gate + files-only + tools/commands, then the probe scenarios + docs. Messages carry gate results including the probe exit code.
acceptance_criteria: A call matching a block rule never executes (L2 against the fake host and L3 probe scenarios glm-rules, non-glm-rules).
Writes into the rules directories are blocked for direct calls and run_code sub-calls; reads are allowed.
No code path in the gate throws out of the listener; failures allow and degrade health with a reason.
The row is still disabled in packages/hourness/cordis.patch.yml; build, preflight, npm test and npm run probe exit 0 (or the probe baseline failure recorded in step 1 is unchanged and named).
verification: npm test (TEMP = system temp directory) exits 0
npm run probe exits 0 (compare with the baseline recorded in step 1)

Design points interpreted rather than followed (flag to the reviewer / orchestrator):
1. Queue is inert in the gate. FEAT-006 lists block, record and inform only; waiting tickets are FEAT-007. A queue hit therefore lets the call run. Consequence: the stop-level entries (and any person's queue rule in a rules file) are not carried out until FEAT-007/008, and rules_show says so.
2. 'git worktree list cached 60 s' is read from <git dir>/worktrees/*/gitdir (worktreesOf, no process): src/rules/ must not import child_process (FEAT-005 acceptance, checked by tests/rules-check.spec.ts) and the result is the list git prints, minus git's own pruning of broken entries. Cache: per project root, 60 s, on the row clock.
3. glmHournessRules exists with one member, declaration. The design's RulesService (attachable, acceptProposal, proposalLine, proposalIdOf, staleEntries) belongs to the blocked proposal path; the guard needs only the line, so the reader checks only declaration and takes a wider service. RULES_DECLARATION is the design's text verbatim and mentions tickets, which do not exist until FEAT-007.
4. rules_propose does not exist, so the refusal text of rules:files-only does not name it (design 6.4 does). The block refusal in denial.ts (FEAT-005) still says 'you may propose a change with rules_propose': a pointer to a tool nobody has until the proposal path is built. Change denial.ts and its pins in tests/rules-check.spec.ts when that path lands, or earlier if the row is to be enabled before.
5. Role: header origin subagent -> subagent; otherwise the projection hournessMainAgent read with sessionProjections.stateOf and mainAgentActive; missing, malformed or absent service reads as root (the design's fallback); a projection that throws leaves the role unknown (rules that ask about role do not apply; rules_show says why). glmHournessDesign does not exist, so the first step after /wish may read as root.
6. targetModel of gate.dispatch: the design takes it from dispatch_task's model parameter; native subagent/subagent_fork carry provider and model together, so targetModel is 'provider/model' when both are given and an empty string (unreadable) otherwise. dispatch_task does not exist yet.
7. rules_show lists, for the caller: person's rules whose role/model/session filters fit it (a field it cannot tell leaves the rule out with one sentence), session rules of its own session, the default pricing rule only where there is a pricing service (absent or wrong-shape service: neither the rule line nor any pricing statement, but the 'GLM peak: unknown (reason)' line stays, which is how the three different reasons are visible), the entries the peak mode enables (filtered by caller), the caller's own open tickets, signals (project's own; glm-peak on its own line), notes about how the state was read, and a provenance sentence with pluginLabel when code entries are listed. The design's 'peak line' (the main agent's reminder line with the worker cap) belongs to FEAT-008; rules_show keeps showText's 'Peak mode:' and 'GLM peak:' lines. The pricing rule line follows the design text without peakHours.en because UsagePricing has no peakHours yet.
8. /rules show answers in Chinese with its own short formatter (commands.ts) instead of the English rules_show text ('人话' in design 9.2). delete's name classification: r- and builtin: -> rule; others -> signal (no detector operation exists).
9. Violation journal: mode enforce for denials (design), record for recorded calls (design); the morning report was changed to count enforce as a violation and record as neither violation nor shadow (src/workflow/morning-report.ts), otherwise those lines would have dropped out of its counts. GuardRecord gained RecordedCall.
10. Row health: the 'unresolved records' message now points at /rules recovery (was: delete .llm/rules/); the two reasons nothing clears (snapshot-modified, journal-shorter) keep the delete .llm/rules/ way out. A clause 'N 条你设的规则生效' is added only when N > 0, so earlier messages are unchanged for projects without rules.
11. The gate asks the pricing service once a minute per pricing service object (peakReader memo), because finding the end of a peak scans minutes and the gate runs on every call. rules_show is not in ORCHESTRATION_RESIDENT_TOOLS: in a GLM session it is a deferred tool; a held GLM subagent therefore cannot reach it through tool search if its tool-search calls are queued by a future stop-level rule. Decide with FEAT-008.
12. inject became ['tools', 'commands'] (design 11.1; patch and test updated); disabled: true unchanged.
13. docs/graph was not touched (task rule), so the graph node rules was not updated from this step; the caller should record the commits and gate results there.
